## Sequence-model intuition {#sec-rnn-throughput}

An RNN computes each hidden state from the previous hidden state, creating a sequential dependency across token positions. This limits parallelism within one sequence and is an important constraint when reasoning about [inference throughput](10-ml-system-reasoning.qmd#q-inference-throughput); batching can parallelize across sequences, but it does not remove the recurrent dependency within each sequence.
